definition: פָּקַד 303 verb attend to, visit, muster, appoint (Late Hebrew id., visit, enjoin ; Phoenician פקד attend to, provide ; Assyrian pa‡âdu = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic lose, miss ; also ( Dozy ) give heed, attention, to ; Ethiopic visit, muster, desire, need , etc.; Nabataean פקד command ( Cook ), so ᵑ7 פְּקַד Pa`el, Syriac , also visit ); — Qal 234 Perfect 3 masculine singular ׳ פ Exod 4:31 +; 1 singular פָּקַדְתִּי Exod 3:16 +, etc.; Imperfect 3 masculine singular יִפְקֹד Gen 50:24 +, etc.; Imperative masculine singular פְּקֹד Num 3:15 +, etc.; Infinitive absolute פָּקֹד Gen 50:24 +; construct לִפְקֹד 2Sam 24:4 +, etc.; Participle active פֹּקֵד Exod 20:5 +; passive (הַ) פְּקֻדִים Exod 30:14 +, construct פְּקוּדֵי Num 31:14 +, etc.; — A. 1. a. pay attention to, observe (with care, practical interest), of ׳ י with accusative of person + of thing Exod 3:16 ( J ), with accusative of person Exod 4:31 ( J ; || רָאָה ), Ps 8:5 (with providence, compare פְּקֻדָּה Job 10:12 || זָכַר ); with accusative of thing 1Sam 15:2 ; Ps 80:15 (|| הִבִּיט , רָאָה ), Lam 4:22 (|| גִּלָּה עַל ), יִוְכֹּר עֲוֺנָם וְיִפְקֹד חַטאֹתָם Hos 8:13 = Hos 9:9 = Jer 14:10 ; 1Sam 17:18 observe thy brothers as to well-being ( לְשָׁלוֺם ; i.e. see how they fare). \ \ b. attend to , in act, see to , with accusative of person 2Kgs 9:34 accusative of sheep Jer 23:2 (in figurative); compare Zech 10:3 b Zech 11:16 . \ \ c. seek (with interest, desire), seek ׳ י Isa 26:16 in bad sense, look about for Ezek 23:21 . Hence \ \ d. seek in vain, need, miss, lack (compare Niph`al , and Arabic Ethiopic above), with accusative of person 1Sam 20:6 ; Isa 34:16 , of thing 1Sam 25:15 ; Jer 3:16 . 2. specifically visit , with accusative, for different purposes: with ( ב ) a present Judg 15:1 especially of ׳ י , visit graciously Gen 21:1 ; Gen 50:24 ; Gen 50:25 = Exod 13:19 (all E ), Isa 23:17 ; Jer 15:15 (|| זָכַר ), Jer 27:22 ; Jer 29:10 ; Ps 65:10 +; בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ Ps 106:4 (|| זָכַר ); visit to search, test, accusative of person Job 7:18 (|| כָּחַן ), Ps 17:3 (|| id. ; object omitted), absolute Job 31:14 to punish Jer 6:15 ; Jer 49:8 ; Jer 50:31 ; Ps 59:6 accusative of person omitted Exod 32:34 a Isa 26:14 , with עַל of thing (of sin) Jer 5:9 ; Jer 5:29 ; Jer 9:8 (here + ב person); accusative of thing Ps 89:33 absolute, of ׳ י 's anger Job 35:15 . 3. with עַל person, visit upon , ׳ י subject, + accusative of thing (of sin) Amos 3:2 ; Amos 3:14 ; Hos 1:4 ; Hos 2:15 ; Exod 20:5 ; Exod 34:7 ; Deut 5:9 + 10 t.; accusative of thing omitted, = punish Isa 10:12 ; Jer 9:24 ; Jer 11:22 ; Jer 13:21 + 10 t. Numbers; + 1Chr 23:24 . B. appoint: 1. with accusative of person + אִתָּם Gen 40:4 , + עַל person over whom Jer 15:3 ; Jer 51:27 ; Num 27:16 , + אֶל (for עַל ) Jer 49:19 = Jer 50:44 with accusative of person alone Num 3:10 , + בְּראֹשׁ הָעָם Deut 20:9 passive participle plural appointed ones, officers , of (fighting) host Num 31:14 ; Num 31:48 ; 2Kgs 11:15 ; 2Chr 23:14 . 2. with accusative of thing, appoint, assign , + עַל person to whom, Num 4:27 (on text see Di ); with accusative of thing only, v Num 4:32 compare Job 34:13 ; Job 36:23 lay upon ( עַל person) as a charge , Zeph 3:7 (reading מֵעֵינֶיהָ , ᵐ5 We Now , for מְעוֺנָהּ ); + infinitive 2Chr 36:23 = Ezra 1:2 = deposit , with accusative of thing + ב location, 2Kgs 5:24 (compare פִּקָּדוֺן ). פָּקַד303 verb attend to, visit, muster, appoint (Late Hebrew id., visit, enjoin; Phoenician פקד attend to, provide; Assyrian pa‡âdu = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic lose, miss; also (Dozy) give heed, attention, to; Ethiopic visit, muster, desire, need, etc.; Nabataean פקד command (Cook), so ᵑ7 פְּקַד Pa`el, Syriac , also visit); —

A. 1. a. pay attention to, observe (with care, practical interest), of ׳י with accusative of person + of thing Exod 3:16 (J), with accusative of person Exod 4:31 (J; || רָאָה), Ps 8:5 (with providence, compare פְּקֻדָּה Job 10:12 || זָכַר); with accusative of thing 1Sam 15:2; Ps 80:15 (|| הִבִּיט, רָאָה), Lam 4:22 (|| גִּלָּה עַל), יִוְכֹּר עֲוֺנָם וְיִפְקֹד חַטאֹתָם Hos 8:13 = Hos 9:9 = Jer 14:10; 1Sam 17:18 observe thy brothers as to well-being (לְשָׁלוֺם; i.e. see how they fare).
\ \ b. attend to, in act, see to, with accusative of person 2Kgs 9:34 accusative of sheep Jer 23:2 (in figurative); compare Zech 10:3 b Zech 11:16.
\ \ c. seek (with interest, desire), seek ׳י Isa 26:16 in bad sense, look about for Ezek 23:21. Hence
\ \ d. seek in vain, need, miss, lack (compare Niph`al, and Arabic Ethiopic above), with accusative of person 1Sam 20:6; Isa 34:16, of thing 1Sam 25:15; Jer 3:16.
2. specifically visit, with accusative, for different purposes: with (ב) a present Judg 15:1 especially of ׳י, visit graciously Gen 21:1; Gen 50:24; Gen 50:25 = Exod 13:19 (all E), Isa 23:17; Jer 15:15 (|| זָכַר), Jer 27:22; Jer 29:10; Ps 65:10 +; בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ Ps 106:4 (|| זָכַר); visit to search, test, accusative of person Job 7:18 (|| כָּחַן), Ps 17:3 (|| id.; object omitted), absolute Job 31:14 to punish Jer 6:15; Jer 49:8; Jer 50:31; Ps 59:6 accusative of person omitted Exod 32:34 a Isa 26:14, with עַל of thing (of sin) Jer 5:9; Jer 5:29; Jer 9:8 (here + ב person); accusative of thing Ps 89:33 absolute, of ׳י's anger Job 35:15.
3. with עַל person, visit upon, ׳י subject, + accusative of thing (of sin) Amos 3:2; Amos 3:14; Hos 1:4; Hos 2:15; Exod 20:5; Exod 34:7; Deut 5:9 + 10 t.; accusative of thing omitted, = punish Isa 10:12; Jer 9:24; Jer 11:22; Jer 13:21 + 10 t. Jeremiah, + 8 t.; + כ of thing Hos 12:3; Jer 21:14 + clause of sin Hos 4:14 with אֶל person Jer 50:18 (twice in verse), אֶל + עַל Jer 46:18 indefinite subject with עַל of vineyard = injure Isa 27:3.
4. pass in review, muster (nearly = number), with accusative, 1Sam 11:8; 1Sam 13:15; 2Sam 24:2; 2Sam 24:4 + 11 t. + Num 1:3; Num 1:19; Num 1:44; Num 1:49 + 16 t. Numbers (P); accusative omitted 1Sam 14:17 (twice in verse); Num 3:42 object נָוֶה Job 5:24 especially passive participle, persons or things mustered (numbered), Exod 30:12; Exod 30:13; Exod 30:14; Exod 38:25; Exod 38:26; Num 1:21; Num 1:22 + 67 t. Numbers; + 1Chr 23:24. B. appoint:
1. with accusative of person + אִתָּם Gen 40:4, + עַל person over whom Jer 15:3; Jer 51:27; Num 27:16, + אֶל (for עַל) Jer 49:19 = Jer 50:44 with accusative of person alone Num 3:10, + בְּראֹשׁ הָעָם Deut 20:9 passive participle plural appointed ones, officers, of (fighting) host Num 31:14; Num 31:48; 2Kgs 11:15; 2Chr 23:14.
2. with accusative of thing, appoint, assign, + עַל person to whom, Num 4:27 (on text see Di); with accusative of thing only, vNum 4:32 compare Job 34:13; Job 36:23 lay upon (עַל person) as a charge, Zeph 3:7 (reading מֵעֵינֶיהָ, ᵐ5 We Now, for מְעוֺנָהּ); + infinitive 2Chr 36:23 = Ezra 1:2 = deposit, with accusative of thing + ב location, 2Kgs 5:24 (compare פִּקָּדוֺן). 1. be (sought, i.e. needed) missed, lacking 1Sam 20:18 + v1Sam 20:19 (ᵐ5, for ᵑ0 תֵּרֵד, We Dr and others), 1Sam 25:7; 1Kgs 20:39 (+ infinitive absolute), 2Kgs 10:19 (twice in verse); Jer 23:4 (Gr Gie conjecture יִפְחָ֖דוּ), + מִן particle Judg 21:3; 1Sam 25:21; 2Sam 2:30; Num 31:49 of seat 1Sam 20:18, place v1Sam 20:25 v1Sam 20:27 (i.e. be empty).

4. be appointed Neh 7:1, + עַל Neh 12:44. Pi`el (intensive) muster a host, Participle מְפַקֵּד Isa 13:4 (of ׳י). Pu`al be passed in review, Perfect 3 masculine singular פֻּקַּד Exod 38:21 be caused to miss, deprived of, 1 singular פֻּקַּדְתִּי Isa 38:10 with accusative of thing,
**sense dubious, Ges am (shall be) missed for; Hi Di De CheComm. am punished, mulcted of. Hothpa`al id., Perfect 3 plural הָתְפָּֽקְדוּ 1Kgs 20:27; Num 1:47; Num 2:33; Num 26:62 (Gesl.c.).
